rationale: Exclude (E01 wrong topic; also fails study design/empirical evidence as a book review). The title and abstract citation indicate a journal book review of a 2004 edited volume on the Mexican state, indigenous peoples, neo-indigenism, legality and identity under the PAN, with no relation to water or sanitation service access, governance of WASH services, empirical primary synthesis or service-access outcomes.
plain_vs_narrow_note: No divergence between narrow and plain Criterion 2 readings: although the reviewed book's title references the state and legality in indigenous politics, the record is a non-empirical book review on Mexican neo-indigenism and identity with no connection to household or community water or sanitation service access or outcomes.
